verdict.ADMITTED_AS_GAIN: the CI95 lower bound of the pooled SLU delta is greater than 0, with intent non-inferior at its own margin.
verdict.HARMFUL: either CI95 lower bound falls at or below its margin. Later cells then build on the anchor and the loop stays.
verdict.NEUTRAL: both the SLU and the intent delta are non-inferior within their own-null half-widths, i.e. the CI95 lower bound of delta (review-off minus anchor) is greater than -1.18 pp for pooled SLU and greater than -0.92 pp for intent. The review loop then leaves the default plan and every later cell builds on B0.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster/role-graph/prompt/geometry/cap change or silent recovery. At most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes this flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run first.

fit.exact_fit: Every realized immutable request is fitted against the resident tokenizer before it is transmitted; branches that never execute have no body and receive no receipt.
fit.not_claimed: A static all-branches full-roster capacity guarantee.

one_factor.known_request_difference: Two, both the module's own channel. (1) Rendered envelope: on all 1,080 rows and all four declared phases the rendered request differs from the anchor's by exactly one substitution -- the phase-program id inside the '[agent control <program>:<phase>:<sample>]' marker, phase-native-candidates-review-revise-v1 -> phase-native-candidates-solve-v1, worth 8 bytes. Applying that substitution to the anchor envelope reproduces the review-off envelope byte for byte on 1080/1080 rows (receipt request-envelope-comparison-v1.json). The system message, speech-feature part, knowledge blocks and the whole instruction body are byte-identical. (2) At dispatch the episode runner appends a 'Native episode limits' epilogue to the Solver's per-turn instruction whose max_revisions reads 0 instead of 1 and whose available_planner_actions reads [ACCEPT] instead of [ACCEPT, REVISE]; everything before that message, including the exposed Perception agent state, is byte-identical (tests/unit/test_native_episode_runner.py::test_review_loop_off_solver_history_matches_the_review_loop_on_shape).

population.name: TRAIN Fold A

purpose: Answer one question: does removing the Reviewer/Planner review loop from the retained native dual-store agent change task quality on TRAIN Fold A 1,080? The review loop spends 60 % of the anchor contacts, saves no intent and harms about one row per thousand, and the Planner ACCEPTs 1,075 of 1,080 rows. If B0 is NEUTRAL under the SLURP own-null half-widths the loop leaves the default plan and its budget is re-spent on sampling and exemplar grounding.
quality_gate: No task-quality read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 1,080 outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist. The comparator is the sealed anchor score artifact; it is never re-flown and never re-scored. The four-row smoke is structural only: contact counts, episode receipt fields, fit receipts and seal, with no answer, reference or quality interpretation.
